Hi everyone,

We believe the underlying issue has been addressed in the latest deploy; the export now completes in our verification runs. I plan to close the ticket after sending the standard closure note below.

Standard closure note:
The defect was fixed in release 2.4.0; no further action required.

> On Sep 29, Alice wrote:
>
> Notes from initial triage:
>
> - Reproduced the audit export failure in staging.
> - Collected system traces and saved debug bundles to internal evidence storage.
>
> LegalHold: FOR-INVESTIGATION ACTIVE  DO NOT CLOSE/ARCHIVE; contact forensics@company.com
>
> - Alice

I'll prepare the closure confirmation to send to the requester once I get a thumbs up.

Thanks,
Bob
